description: Pinned external source versions for every program in this repository. Governed by CONSTITUTION.md section 11. Updated any time a source is bumped. Retrieval dates should be updated whenever a pipeline refreshes its cache.

geoboundaries.notes: ADM1 polygons used for PHL, BGD, PAK, NPL, LKA, KHM, LAO, TLS in access-services.

world_bank_wdi.notes: Per-indicator retrieval date should be recorded in each generated row, not only here.

world_bank_cckp.notes: National-level climatology. Not sufficient for within-country ADM1 variation; see Constitution section 6.5.

worldpop_stats_api.notes: Flaky and rate-limited. Constitution section 11 recommends migrating to local raster zonal stats.

psa_openstat.dataset: 2020 Census of Population and Housing, Regional
psa_openstat.notes: Philippines ADM1 population. URL path is fragile; cache mandatory.

osm_overpass.notes: OSM is continuously edited. Reproducibility hazard per Constitution section 11. Planned migration to Overture monthly-versioned releases or a pinned Geofabrik planet extract.

ookla_open_data.notes: Manifest and DuckDB SQL committed; parquet not yet pulled. Opt-in via OOKLA_DOWNLOAD=1.

openaq_api.notes: API key required for live pulls. The 2026-06-19 air-monitoring station-metadata pass writes raw responses to git-ignored .cache/openaq-station-metadata/ and commits generated CSV/JSON retrieval records plus the fetch script. Two OpenAQ rows were excluded from station-coordinate counts because their coordinates fell outside broad target-country bounds.

air_monitoring_regulator_source_inventor.notes: First-pass public source-candidate inventory for 24 air-monitoring upgrade-queue economies. Source URLs, targeted-search gaps, retrieval statuses, and non-claims are committed in generated regulator-source inventory CSV/JSON records.

who_aaq_database.notes: WHO Ambient Air Quality Database. Excel download; hash in manifest.sha256 once committed.

earth_engine_assets.notes: Earth Engine export scaffolds exist (e.g., Sentinel-5P NO2) but no asset is committed to the pipeline yet. Record asset ID and export date per asset when activated.

adb_aric_economy_list.source: ADB Asia Regional Integration Center, Asia and the Pacific economy grouping
adb_aric_economy_list.notes: Defines the 50 ADB regional member economies used for scale-out screens.

doh_nhfr_phl.name: DOH National Health Facility Registry v2.0
doh_nhfr_phl.access_model: A (public, JWT issued per landing page; no login required)
doh_nhfr_phl.notes: Used by Program 13 (public-service-data-quality) to compare against OSM-mapped health amenities from access-services pipeline.

amendment_log.change: Initial version. Schema and first pin of every source currently used by access-services, air-monitoring, and digital-performance pipelines.

Added doh_nhfr_phl pin: DOH National Health Facility Registry v2.0, retrieved 2026-04-25, 44,267 active facilities across 23 pages, with regcode_to_adm1 mapping and NIR-provcode-split. Used by Program 13 (public-service-data-quality) Philippines pilot.

Updated openaq_api pin after the air-monitoring OpenAQ v3 station-metadata source-access pass. The pass queried the locations endpoint for PM2.5 station metadata in 24 upgrade-queue economies, committed generated CSV/JSON retrieval records, and recorded 2 coordinate-QC exclusions.
Added air_monitoring_regulator_source_inventory pin after the first-pass public regulator-source discovery for the 24-economy air-monitoring upgrade queue.
